scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the January 14 raku workshop prep usable for the planned smoky-glaze segment without changing the class plan.
Emerging Need: A tentative studio block becomes a confirmed task that requires a specific respirator-cartridge setup, while the stored supply is found unusable before the session.
Decision Context: Saved studio guidance identifies which cartridge type matters and rules out casual substitutes; current messages and store notices determine whether a reversible local hold remains possible.
Consequence: If the hold window passes, the required protection cannot be obtained before setup, even though the workshop has not begun and no preparation attempt is blocked.

parameter.title: Raku workshop studio prep and demo
parameter.description: Planning placeholder; firing duties and prep list to be confirmed by the program lead.

parameter.subject: Confirmed raku duties for Jan 14
parameter.body: Your January 14 raku workshop block is confirmed for 9:00 to 12:30. Please lead the smoky-glaze mixing table and assist with post-fire kiln-shelf cleanout after the demo firing. The final prep list will go out Monday morning.

parameter.content: I checked your labeled PPE bin while clearing shelf space. There isn't a sealed cartridge pair in it, only the opened OV/P100 set marked "opened 2025-09" and a couple of plain dust masks.

parameter.subject: Small restock: North 7581P100 cartridge pairs
parameter.body: We received two North 7581P100 organic-vapor/P100 cartridge pairs this morning. For local educators, we can hold one set by reply or phone until Sunday, January 11 at 4:00 PM, with pickup no later than Monday, January 12 at 6:00 PM. No prepayment is required for the hold.

parameter.subject: North 7581P100 restock sold through
parameter.body: The two North 7581P100 pairs from Saturday's shipment have now sold, and no educator holds remain open. The next restock is expected January 15 after 2:00 PM.
